# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub:
[Security > Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Mr-Dark-debug/Moonfold/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue for a security problem. Include the affected version, your operating
system, steps to reproduce, and the impact you observed.

We aim to acknowledge reports within 3 days and to share a fix plan within 14 days. Please give us
a reasonable chance to fix the problem before disclosing it publicly. We credit reporters in the
release notes unless you ask us not to.

## Scope

In scope: the Moonfold desktop app, the `moonfold` server and CLI, the web client it serves, and
the release artifacts published from this repository.

Out of scope: the provider CLIs Moonfold launches (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor and
others) and their services. Report those to their vendors.

## Safe harbor

Good-faith research that respects user data, avoids service disruption, and follows this policy
is welcome. Moonfold is local-first: test against your own installation and accounts only.
